You know the deal. I'll be writing this soon. It's a Celeste(tm) map with rooms and gameplay.
Anyways... Uploading five minutes before the deadline is bad for my heart, I'm getting older I think.
(warning: profanities ahead, and a glimpse into my batshit insane mind)
The past month I've been working a whole lot for my internship (dox me, I'm bored), and especially long days 'till past midnight sometimes, because of its nature. I struggled with finding time, and only really started halfway through the contest.
Some of the rooms are scuffed because I sketched them first at work, another one is scuffed because I made it two hours before the deadline! So naturally that one didn't get a lot of outsider playtesting, as my designated playtester already went to sleep. It's late here.
Anyways back to my, uh, story.
I started making some decent progress during the last week, getting about halfway through the map and thinking up some new ideas for the rest, but then I didn't get a whole lot done nearing the weekend. Saturday I worked 'till one at night, and Sunday I went to the city with a friend, to do something, I wouldn't say questionable, but it's certainly not something you do every day.
Also on my way there I got hit by a f*cking (small) truck while cycling like BAM I'm sent flying, for a moment I can see my own heartbeat, my bones are breaking mid-air, and outside of my body. Moments later I'm bleeding dry on the pavement.
(It wasn't really that bad, I only got a cut on my leg 'cause I kinda just fell over after the truck hit my back wheel, which'll probably leave a scar, but hey I collect those like stamps nowadays. Also my phone got some new cracks but they look sorta interesting so I f*ck with it. It's a secret just for the internet to know.)
I did some more work in the evening I think, I was semi-drunk (that's not a thing is it). And then today (Sunday(and/well now Monday)) (wait no that's monday, now tuesday) I finished up, speedran two rooms, played the Aiframe Ultra Beta, cried, didn't actually cry that's a lie, Celeste you can't hurt me, placed so many tiles, deco'ed, added custom ambience which didn't loop properly even after making it loop properly so I had to make it fade in and out.
Oh yes I cannot forget, my good business partner PotatoLucy made a really amazing piece of (pixel-)art for the map! I cannot thank her enough for this.
I think I'm close to everything I wanted to say.
Oh yeah about the song of course! I don't actually know a whole lot about it, I checked out a translation of the lyrics once to see if there was anything relevant I should keep in mind.
I originally heard it at home on this compilation LP by this label it was released under I suppose. I don't know what the remaster is about/for, I don't know who made it, I'll just link it here everywhere and you'll figure it out yourself (if you'd wanna). This yellow text hurts my eyes.

And the map of course, features:
  • five or six gameplay rooms
  • some 'I-don't-wanna-call-it-advanced-so-I'll-say-expert' "ridg" type gameplay, for the fans
  • two whole berries

Let me check my notes now.

Some special thanks:
- Fortress Fall by Aspar @ Strawberry Jam for being the main inspiration for the gameplay.
- "Jitter" paint.net plugin by 'Pyrochild' for helping make the sick sun reflection on the ocean.
- This and This for the ambience.
- Compound, a friend (I think) of mine, for uh, no reason at all.
- PotatoLucy obviously for playtesting, moral support, the big custom art, and some ideas/motivation for the last room.
- And last but not least, Nyan and Touhoe for once again hosting this amazing contest, much love.
- Poor Richard
- Niesmand
Lovely, now that that's over I want to go to sleep, please leave me be!
